found: Exactly one record in a chain MUST carry any given `previousHash` value

note: Nothing in the text requires the predecessor relation to be injective. Two records may carry the same previousHash, so a chain is a tree and the presenter chooses the branch. The subject digest is the genesis hash, which is identical on both branches, so a policy targeting the chain cannot tell them apart. No hash is broken and no second genesis appears.
